reference_zdoom3ds.usage: OS adapters, generated XLAT parser, ARM config headers and RSF mappings. The game engine remains Zandronum. Native NDSP/CSND backend and decoder adapters adapted to Zandronum audio ABI.

mbedtls.usage: TLS 1.2 server browser, verified ISRG Root X1, PS hardware RNG, no TLS work during gameplay

reference_prboom3ds.usage: Reference for native HID/IRRST polling, continuous stick input and touchscreen mouse behavior; no engine substitution.

libogg.configuration: ARM32 config_types.h uses signed int for Tremor exponent pointer compatibility.

dsp_firmware_extractor.usage: Read-only extraction from the running console; no Nintendo firmware in the distribution.
